Experiments were carried out to investigate the rate at which products were formed by two digestive enzymes, P and Q over a period of 30 minutes.
P and Q have similar optimum conditions for function. Only the enzyme and its substrate were changed between each reaction.
The results are shown in the graphs.
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

1 During the first 10 minutes, the rate of reaction (mgmin$^{-1}$) with enzyme P is double the rate with enzyme Q.
2 A possible explanation for the difference in the shape between the graphs is that the product of the reaction catalysed by P significantly alters the pH of the solution.
3 The percentage change in mass of product formed by enzyme Q is more than 5 times greater between 6.5 and 15 minutes than it is between 24 and 29 minutes.
